title: Zhu Zhu Xia: Hai Yang Ri Ji

alternative_titles.ja: 猪猪侠大电影·海洋日记,

synopsis:
The story follows the super-agent GG Bond, who—despite suffering lingering effects from a previous mission—insists on venturing alone into the underwater world for a new assignment. Amidst a vibrant, colorful realm teeming with diverse marine life, he meets a little creature named "Little Sprout" who is searching for his missing brother. 

(Source: Baidu Bake, translated)
